$comment: Single source of truth for the parent-category taxonomy. Consumed by both lib/category-map.ts (the Next.js app) and scripts/import-partner.mjs (the import script), so a product's parent category is guaranteed identical whether it's being rendered on the site or being classified during import. Rules are checked in array order, first match wins, matched as a case-insensitive substring against the raw subcategory name. A raw subcategory that matches nothing falls through to the 'fallback' parent below — so every product always gets a parent category, even one from a keyword set nobody anticipated yet. To add a new parent category (or teach an existing one about a new kind of product), edit this file only — nothing else needs to change.
